description: Education Counts maintains a national directory of New Zealand schools. The page offers a directory builder and school details, including location and enrolment information. The directory refreshes nightly, while administrative changes and roll estimates can lag. It supports identification and capacity context for education facilities; it does not provide building condition or a guaranteed count of occupants at a particular time. Published by New Zealand Ministry of Education. Spatial and temporal resolution are source-dependent; any detail not stated above remains unknown. The provider lists CSV access formats. Reuse licence: Unknown; no data or software reuse licence established from the reviewed metadata. Cost or acquisition terms remain to be confirmed with the provider. Potential simulation uses include capacity planning, hazard exposure. Related catalogue records: platform-qgis. These are contextual links, not a claim of a tested integration.
